# Indikator 11: Andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atriflimren, som får alvorlig blødning inden for 1 år

This indicator measures the proportion of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients who develop serious bleeding within one year, a critical safety metric for anticoagulation treatment.

## Mentions

- Page 77: "Indikator 11: Andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atriflimren, som får alvorlig blødning inden for 1 år" [^src1]

## Relationships

- [[atrieflimren|Atrieflimren]] — measures-outcome-in [^src1]. Evidence: "Indikator 11 measures serious bleeding in newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients within 1 year" (Page 77)
- [[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]] — is-tracked-by (incoming) — "Serious bleeding is the outcome measured by Indicator 11" [^src1] (Page 77)

## Claims

- For Indicator 11 (serious bleeding in newly diagnosed patients), Denmark overall showed 691 / 21,804 patients (3.2%, 95% CI 2.9-3.4) developing serious bleeding in the period 01.07.2022 - 30.06.2023 ([[indikator-11-serious-bleeding-newly-diagnosed]], [[danmark|Danmark]])
- Region Hovedstaden reported 166 / 5,905 patients (2.8%, 95% CI 2.4-3.3) with serious bleeding for Indicator 11 ([[indikator-11-serious-bleeding-newly-diagnosed]], [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]])
- Region Sjælland reported 111 / 3,590 patients (3.1%, 95% CI 2.6-3.7) with serious bleeding for Indicator 11 ([[indikator-11-serious-bleeding-newly-diagnosed]], [[sjaelland|Sjælland]])
- Region Syddanmark reported 187 / 4,972 patients (3.8%, 95% CI 3.2-4.3) with serious bleeding for Indicator 11 ([[indikator-11-serious-bleeding-newly-diagnosed]], [[syddanmark|Syddanmark]])
- Region Midtjylland reported 155 / 4,918 patients (3.2%, 95% CI 2.7-3.7) with serious bleeding for Indicator 11 ([[indikator-11-serious-bleeding-newly-diagnosed]], [[midtjylland|Midtjylland]])
